verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye saṁviggā yoniso padahanti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who, being inspired, strive effectively are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye saṁviggā yoniso na padahanti.
verses.english: while those who, even though inspired, don’t strive effectively are many.
